notes.sowing: Put supports in first, then sow outdoors {cm:2.5} to {cm:5} deep, one or two seeds at the base of each pole or cane, 1 to 4 weeks after your last frost once the soil is at least {c:16}. Thin to the strongest seedling.
notes.care: Give a trellis, wigwam or netting at least {cm:180} tall. Water evenly during flowering. Hot spells above {c:32} can stop pods setting for a while; cropping resumes when it cools.
notes.harvest: Pick pods at {cm:15} to {cm:20}, before the seeds bulge, every few days. Regular picking keeps plants bearing from midsummer until frost.
